mapper.update: UPDATE tb_member SET locked_until = IF(login_fail_count + 1 >= 5, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE), locked_until), status = IF(login_fail_count + 1 >= 5, 'LOCKED', status), captcha_required_yn = IF(login_fail_count + 1 >= 5, 'Y', captcha_required_yn), login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1 WHERE member_id = #{userId}

UPDATE tb_admin SET locked_until = IF(login_fail_count + 1 >= 5, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE), locked_until), status = IF(login_fail_count + 1 >= 5, 'LOCKED', status), captcha_required_yn = IF(login_fail_count + 1 >= 5, 'Y', captcha_required_yn), login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1 WHERE admin_id = #{userId}

UPDATE tb_member SET login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, captcha_required_yn = 'N', status = IF(status = 'LOCKED', 'ACTIVE', status), last_login_at = NOW(), last_login_ip = #{clientIp}, last_access_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{userId}

UPDATE tb_admin SET login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, captcha_required_yn = 'N', status = IF(status = 'LOCKED', 'ACTIVE', status), last_login_at = NOW(), last_login_ip = #{clientIp}, last_access_at = NOW() WHERE admin_id = #{userId}
